commit_subject: (screen-flagged) b1.6 certify (PR #1300): diff changes the Brazil gate in every generated composition from `not entry_is_line_b` to `not entry_is_section_232_aluminum` and re-grounds the steel parameter proof from 9903.81.87/.88 to 9903.82.02; report says "The task's 9903.81.x locator is stale for this corpus vintage".
description: The generated compositions move from the witness's five per-line exemplar flags to membership-semantic caller inputs, and gain a Section 232 steel component the witness never had.

triage.pre_fix_wrong_because: The Brazil IEEPA exception was conditioned on the witness's exemplar line identity `entry_is_line_b` rather than Section 232 aluminum membership, so the 40% Brazil surcharge was added to aluminum entries the cited 9903.01.77 exception exempts.
triage.triage_notes: Same pattern as index 0: 20 changed lines, exactly two Brazil-gate hunks plus the steel proof re-grounding, nothing else. Diff read in full; provision resolution and follow-up-commit notes from index 0 apply verbatim.
triage.verifier_justification: The refutation attempts fail: the diff changes a formula condition in two rules (ieepa_component_rate and ieepa_component_rate_with_declared_exceptions), so it is not mechanical, and the file is a rulespec/v1 module with rules, formulas and proof atoms, so it is not a non-module. The pre-fix module itself attaches an exception atom to that very formula path quoting "The additional duties imposed by heading 9903.01.77 shall not apply to products of aluminum provided for in heading 9903.85.02", yet gated the carve-out on `entry_is_line_b` — the witness's exemplar-line identity (the module's own `entry_is_reciprocal_metals_excluded` is defined as `formula: entry_is_line_b`), which has no basis in that text; the pinned release confirms 9903.01.77 is the Brazil +40% IEEPA heading and 9903.85.02 is "products of aluminum provided for in ... note 19 ... (g)", so the source class is aluminum membership, exactly what the fix substitutes using the module's already-present `entry_is_section_232_aluminum` input. That is a condition with no grounding in the cited provision being re-grounded, which is untraceable_branch rather than a missing clause (the clause was present but wrongly grounded) or a mere scope tweak. The steel half of the diff (9903.81.87/.88 → 9903.82.02) is citation/excerpt-only with the rate unchanged at '0.50', i.e. mechanical provenance, but it does not displace the substantive Brazil-gate change.

triage.verifier_notes: Caveats a reviewer should weigh. (1) Numerically inert in this module: ch02 is meat and edible meat offal, so for any real ch02 line both `entry_is_line_b` (the witness's 7601.10.30.00 aluminum exemplar) and `entry_is_section_232_aluminum` are false; the defect is in encoded meaning and in the generated template shared across ~100 chapters, not in ch02's computed rate. (2) Intra-PR self-repair: the parent a9562cfd ("b1.6: generalize generated component surfaces") is the immediately preceding commit on PR #1300's own branch, so the wrong gate never reached main — it is the generalization pass missing one gate, which this "certify" commit closes. Supporting evidence that it is a genuine miss rather than a design choice: the module summary is byte-identical in pre and post and already states that section-232 aluminum identifiers "are caller inputs supplied by entry preparation" and that only "Beer/section-338 keeps entry_is_line_d because no membership module exists" — the pre file contradicted its own contract. (3) Residual, worth flagging separately: `entry_is_reciprocal_metals_excluded` still has `formula: entry_is_line_b` post-fix (line 1925) with a 9903.01.33 "articles of aluminum; derivative articles of aluminum" atom, so the same exemplar coupling survives in that rule. (4) Source verification limit: the pinned corpus is 2026 Rev 3 (us-rulespec-2026-08-08-obbb-alien-snap) while the module claims Rev 15 vintage, so `us/statute/hts/chapter-99/page-219` resolves to an unrelated derivative-list page and the quoted aluminum carve-out sentence could not be re-read at that locator; 9903.01.77 and 9903.85.02 resolve cleanly and corroborate the semantics. (5) A defensible alternative kind is wrong_entity_or_scope (exception scoped to one exemplar line instead of the aluminum class); untraceable_branch is preferred because the pre condition is a scaffold identity with no source basis at all and the fix re-grounds it.
